Class EmployeeDao

java.lang.Object
sakaboba.dao.EmployeeDao
public class EmployeeDao extends Object
Loads and manages employees in the database. Each database operation opens and closes its own connection.

  • Method Details

    • findAll

      public List<Employee> findAll()
      Loads all employees, sorted by name and then ID.
      Returns:
      the employees, or an empty list if none exist
      Throws:
      DataAccessException - if the database connection or query fails

    • insert

      public Employee insert(String name, String role)
      Creates an employee with a database-allocated ID. Leading and trailing whitespace is stripped from the name and role. ID allocation and insertion run in one transaction with a table lock.
      Parameters:
      name - employee name; must contain 1 to 100 Unicode code points after stripping
      role - employee role; must contain 1 to 50 Unicode code points after stripping
      Returns:
      the saved employee with its assigned ID and stripped name and role
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if either input is null, blank, or too long
      DataAccessException - if the database operation fails

    • update

      public void update(int id, String name, String role)
      Updates an existing employee's name and role. Leading and trailing whitespace is stripped from both text values.
      Parameters:
      id - positive ID of the employee to update
      name - employee name; must contain 1 to 100 Unicode code points after stripping
      role - employee role; must contain 1 to 50 Unicode code points after stripping
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the ID is not positive or either text value is null, blank, or too long
      DataAccessException - if the employee no longer exists or the database operation fails

    • delete

      public void delete(int id)
      Deletes an employee who is not referenced by existing orders.
      Parameters:
      id - positive ID of the employee to delete
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the ID is not positive
      DataAccessException - if the employee no longer exists, is referenced by another record, or the database operation fails

    • validateText

      private static String validateText(String value, String label, int limit)
      Strips surrounding whitespace and checks a required text field's length.
      Parameters:
      value - text to validate; null is treated as empty
      label - field name used in validation error messages
      limit - maximum permitted length in Unicode code points
      Returns:
      the stripped, nonempty text
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the stripped text is empty or exceeds the limit

    • validateId

      private static void validateId(int id)
      Checks that an employee ID is positive.
      Parameters:
      id - employee ID to validate
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the ID is zero or negative

    • requireChanged

      private static void requireChanged(int rows)
      Checks that an update or delete affected an employee record.
      Parameters:
      rows - number of rows affected by the SQL statement
      Throws:
      DataAccessException - if no rows were affected

    • failure

      private DataAccessException failure(String message, SQLException error)
      Logs a database failure and wraps its cause for the calling panel. This method returns the exception; the caller is responsible for throwing it.
      Parameters:
      message - explanation suitable for display to the user
      error - original SQL exception
      Returns:
      an exception containing the display message and original cause
